name: Kiran Syntex Limited
summary: Kiran Syntex Limited specializes in the production and distribution of dyed polyester yarns. Its diverse product range encompasses varieties such as polyester filament dyed yarn, polyester air textured dyed yarn, polyester slub dyed yarn, and polyester space dyed yarn. Established on October 21, 1986, the company maintains its primary operational base in Surat, India.
